Abrolhos & the Bahia coast: A marine park and the coast beside it, chosen as one humpback trip.

Cook Islands: A small island country, one decision.

High Island: A tiny town on the Texas coast, a few days in spring.
Hortobágy National Park: One park, one crane trip, about two hours from Budapest.

Iguazu Falls: One famous site shared by two countries, visited once.
iSimangaliso Wetland Park: One large park on the KwaZulu-Natal coast.
Isla Guadalupe: A remote island visited once for shark cage diving.
Itatiaia National Park: One park a few hours from Rio, a stop on a longer trip.

Jigokudani Monkey Park: One park, a day trip from Nagano or Tokyo.
Jim Corbett National Park: One park, the usual safari decision in the north.
Jocotoco Reserves: A network of reserves in different parts of Ecuador, hours apart.
Kaikōura: A one or two night stop between Christchurch and Picton. Could fold into a South Island coast place.
Kangaroo Island: An island chosen as one decision.
Katmai National Park: One park, a fly-in bear trip.
Kenai Peninsula: A peninsula chosen as one Alaska trip.

Kgalagadi Transfrontier Park: One park spanning a border, one decision.
Koh Samui & Gulf Islands: The Gulf islands as one decision, on the opposite monsoon from the Andaman coast.
Lake Bogoria: A single lake, a day trip from Nakuru or Baringo.

Mafia Island: A small island chosen as one decision.

Malta & Gozo: A small island country, one decision.
Midway Atoll: A single atoll, currently closed to visitors.
Monarch Butterfly Biosphere Reserve: One reserve two to three hours from Mexico City, open November to March.
Mozambique: Gorongosa and Niassa: Two parks more than 700 miles apart, each its own trip.
Mozambique: Tofo and Bazaruto: Two coastal bases about 200 miles apart.
Nagarhole and Bandipur: Two adjoining parks in one landscape.
Norfolk Coast: One coastal region, one birding trip.
Nuquí & Bahía Solano: Two nearby coastal towns on Colombia's Pacific coast, one trip.

Otago Peninsula: A peninsula by Dunedin, a day or two.
Peninsular Malaysia: Taman Negara, Fraser's Hill and the coast are separate trips.
Phillip Island: An island near Melbourne, a day trip for the penguin parade.
Platte River: A stretch of river in Nebraska for a few weeks each March.
Point Pelee: One small national park, a warbler weekend in May.
Poyang Lake: One lake, one winter crane trip.
Pribilof Islands: A remote island pair, visited once.

Roatán & the Bay Islands: A small island group, one decision.
Salalah & Dhofar: A southern region of Oman for humpbacks. It sits inside the Oman entry.
Salton Sea: A lake about an hour from Palm Springs, a day trip.

Serra dos Órgãos National Park: One park a couple of hours from Rio.
Skomer Island: A small island reached on a day boat from Pembrokeshire.
Socorro (Revillagigedo Islands): Remote islands reached by liveaboard, visited once.

South Georgia Island: A single island, an expedition-ship trip.
Southeast Arizona: A loop of canyons and ranges in the southeast corner, one trip.
St. Vincent & the Grenadines: A small island country, one decision.
Stewart Island: A single island, visited once for kiwi.
Sulawesi: A large island. Tangkoko, Lore Lindu and the south are separate trips.

Tanzania south and west: Ruaha, Nyerere: Three remote parks, each reached by its own flight.
Texel: One island about 90 minutes from Amsterdam, a short trip.

Way Kambas National Park: One park inside Sumatra, which is also on the same list.

Wolong & Balang Mountain: One reserve and mountain pass, one trip. Chengdu is only the gateway.
Wrangel Island: A single remote island, visited once.
Yala National Park: One park inside Sri Lanka, which is already a place.
Yap: A single island, a complete manta trip.
Yunnan: A province with several separate trips: Lijiang, Shangri-La, Xishuangbanna and Gaoligongshan.
Zanzibar: An island chosen as one decision, split from Serengeti.
